images/000000478717.jpg: The red and green parrot leans over a book beside dark chairs. That makes its perch look out of place and its feathers especially bright.
images/000000137788.jpg: Bottles line the shelves above a dog curled up underneath. The packed pantry makes its little resting spot seem funny and snug.
images/000000020371.jpg: The pigeon grips a diagonal gutter with nothing but soft green behind it. That plain backdrop makes the still bird stand out.
images/000000231022.jpg: A slash of sunlight picks out one eye while the cat’s face stays in shadow. The contrast makes the portrait feel severe.
images/000000068293.jpg: The small bird has a red throat under a bright green crown. Those colors catch my eye even though the bird sits still.
images/000000196355.jpg: Two riders sit upright on stationary horses in black and white. That stillness makes the pair look formally posed.
images/000000480205.jpg: The heron’s neck bends above sharp blades of grass. The smooth curve looks graceful against those jagged shapes.
images/000000066652.jpg: The giraffe’s legs are folded in the grass while its neck points straight up. The difference in proportions looks comical.
images/000000516328.jpg: A gray crane stands beside a hydrant with a blue cap and yellow post. The hydrant almost upstages the bird with its color.
images/000000177529.jpg: The kitten stretches from its stool toward a much larger dog’s nose. The tiny gap between their noses makes the meeting look gentle.
images/000000557329.jpg: Leaves and stems cross the outline of the perched bird. I find the picture hard to enjoy because the subject is hard to pick out.
images/000000132760.jpg: Spectators, rails and tent poles fill the space behind the pony. The scene feels busy because my eye keeps moving off the animal.
images/000000221542.jpg: The bird’s jutting beak and long toes fill the close view. Those features give it an intimidating rather than a pretty look.
images/000000493438.jpg: A striped foal rests at the standing zebra’s feet in the shade. Their positions make the pair look peaceful together.
images/000000438107.jpg: One orange bill looms near the camera and a second swan bends its neck the other way. The two angles make an amusing pair.
images/000000022894.jpg: Floppy ears frame a white stripe between the puppy’s eyes as it lies in the grass. I find that quiet face endearing.
